budget_allocation.organic_baseline: Days 1-7: $0/day - Let organic performance guide ad spend
budget_allocation.boosted_content: Days 8-30: Up to $50/day on top performers
budget_allocation.viral_amplification: Unlimited spend on posts that hit 100k+ views (cap at $200/day per post)
budget_allocation.platform_ads: Optional: $100/day on TikTok Spark Ads or Instagram Reels Ads for top 3 posts

phase_1_days_1_7.strategy: Organic only - test hooks, templates, timing

phase_3_days_15_21.strategy: Scale winners, test new hooks with small budgets
phase_3_days_15_21.allocation: $70/day - 60% to proven winners, 40% to new tests

phase_4_days_22_30.strategy: All-in on viral content, maximize reach before campaign end
phase_4_days_22_30.allocation: $100/day - prioritize posts with highest conversion rates

tiktok_spark_ads.description: Promote your existing organic TikTok posts as ads
tiktok_spark_ads.setup: TikTok Ads Manager → Spark Ads → Select organic post
tiktok_spark_ads.recommended_for: Posts that already have 10k+ organic views

tiktok_top_view.description: Full-screen ad when users open TikTok app

instagram_reels_ads.description: Promote Reels in Instagram feed and Reels tab
benefits: Reaches Instagram users who don't see TikTok
instagram_reels_ads.setup: Meta Ads Manager → Create Campaign → Reels Placement

lookalike_audiences.seed: Website visitors who viewed order page (from Stripe customer list)

exclusions: People under 18 (unlikely to have purchasing power)

boost_immediately_if: Post hits 50k views in first 24 hours
Post drives 50+ website visits organically in first day
Comments show high purchase intent ('where can I buy this?', 'link?', 'take my money')
increase_budget_if: CPA < $15 (each customer costs less than $15 to acquire)
Post is trending upward (views increasing hour-over-hour)

kpis.break_even_point: $9 order - $3 stripe fee = $6 profit. CPA must be under $6 to break even on first purchase.

lifetime_value_calculation.assumption: 10% of customers order again within 6 months
lifetime_value_calculation.acceptable_cpa_with_ltv: $20 (losses on first order, profit on repeat orders)

optimization_checklist: Pause ads with ROAS < 1.0 after 72 hours
Increase budget on ads with ROAS > 3.0
Test different audiences (pet owners vs gift givers vs art collectors)
A/B test ad copy (price-focused vs emotion-focused)
Retarget website visitors who didn't purchase (separate campaign, $10/day)
Create lookalike audiences from purchasers after first 50 sales

contingency_plans.if_all_ads_fail: Double down on organic content, collaborate with pet influencers for shoutouts
contingency_plans.if_one_post_goes_mega_viral: Pause other ads, put all budget ($200/day) into amplifying the viral post
contingency_plans.if_budget_runs_out_early: Switch to pure organic, focus on engagement-bait content (polls, questions)

reporting_template.daily: Total spend: $X | Revenue: $Y | ROAS: Z | Top post: [hook]
reporting_template.weekly: Week X: Spent $A, Made $B, ROAS C, Acquired D customers at $E CPA
reporting_template.campaign_end: 30-day total: Spent $1500, Made $X, ROAS Y%, Customers Z, Avg CPA $W, Key learnings: ...
